title: candidate-heterostructure-prescreen@1.0
description: Design-only candidate-local schema for a future geometry-only heterostructure prescreen. No semantic validator or operational producer is implemented, so schema-valid records cannot accept, reject, select, materialize, route, queue, or calculate real candidates. The current development claim remains no_positive_claim; geometric_eligibility_only is only a future post-promotion ceiling.

workflow_states.description: Four orthogonal state axes. No axis may be inferred from another.
